svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ring: cut an 80 mm band from 10 in (254 mm) black stovepipe.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tabs: at the foot, at 30, 90, 150 ... degrees, cut six slits 20 mm deep

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and 20 mm apart and fold the tabs out flat. Drill each for a 4.8 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: steel rivet, 10 mm from the ring.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top: cut a 266 mm disc from 18 ga uncoated steel, fold a 12 mm edge

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: down over the ring and rivet it in six places.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a 4 in hole in the middle and rivet in the 4 in crimped start

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: collar; fit the 4 in pipe to 160 mm above the jacket cap.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill a 4 mm hole 95 mm from the centre for thermocouple T8.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: tabs riveted to the lid between the inner wells; AES rope pressed

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: round the foot of the ring. The six short legs end inside it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: No zinc: use uncoated steel and steel rivets only.
